text:
Nick Robertson has 7 goals and zero assists in 17 games, which might be the most Nick Robertson stat line possible. The former Maple Leaf, traded to Pittsburgh, is shooting 20.6%, far above his 13% from last season, and Yardbarker's headline that he's "finding something in Pittsburgh" is fair.

Our numbers say part of it is real and part of it isn't. He has 3.74 expected goals, so he's scoring about twice as often as his chances would predict. That finishing rate rarely lasts. But the chances are real, and the Penguins take 61% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five with him on the ice, nearly 11 points better than without him. That second number is the more interesting one for a 13-minute forward.

He's 25, a 2019 second-round pick who scored 55 goals in 46 OHL games in his last junior season, and he's played 13 minutes a night here. Our projection puts his season at about 24 goals and 37 points, which assumes the shooting comes back to earth. If the minutes rise, the goals will too. Assists would be nice.
headline: Nick Robertson is finishing everything
